boundaries: This policy is disabled by default. Set auto_enabled=true only after manual review.
The auto executor never bypasses v6a_guarded_runner release gate, quote/account gates, managed-state sell guard, or notional limits.
The kill switch file blocks all real auto execution immediately.
Only one real auto execution is allowed per market date.
No executable orders is treated as a safe no-op, not a failure.
This mechanism is designed to be reusable by future mature V6AB execution once V6AB is promoted.
